# design-taste-frontend (vendored)

`SKILL.md` here is a verbatim copy from
[Leonxlnx/taste-skill](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill), file
`skills/taste-skill/SKILL.md`.

**Do not edit `SKILL.md`.** Project-specific limits on when this skill may fire live in
`AGENTS.md` under "Skill precedence", so this file stays a clean copy and updating is a
straight overwrite.

To update:

    git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill.git
    copy taste-skill\skills\taste-skill\SKILL.md .agents\skills\design-taste-frontend\

Scope reminder: **public pages only** (landing, pricing, login). Never dashboard or
admin screens.
